test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

After a while, / she look up / and saw that / it was getting dark.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect verb form "**look**" instead of "**looked**."
 
• In** past tense **narratives, the verb should be in the past form.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**she looked up**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"After a while, she** looked up **and saw that it was getting dark."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **After a while,** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **and saw that** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **it was getting dark.** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
